title: Finite affine charts give gluing data and compatible matching sections
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative local ring with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$, $C$ its $\mathfrak m$-adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $U\subset\operatorname{Spec} A$ exactly the complement of the closed point. Let $q:Y\to U$ and $s:E\to\operatorname{Spec} C$ be finite morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and let $D$ be an overlap identification with its explicit matching ring $B$ [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Fix $t\in\mathbf N$ and $f:\{0,\ldots,t-1\}\to A$ generating $\mathfrak m$. Let $g:C\to\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_E)$ be the structural ring map. There exist module glueing data $X$ for $A\to C$ and $f$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data], a $C$-linear equivalence $e:X.M\prime\simeq\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_E)$ with scalar action via $g$, and a function $k:H^0(X)\to B$ [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-H0], such that the second pullback projection of $k(h)$ equals $e(p(h))$ for every compatible family $h$. This assertion makes no claim about the span of prime coordinates or about surjectivity of the completed comparison.

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first two proof paragraphs (affine charts and overlap data); Tag 05EL, definition of H0. https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BLH and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/05EL

proof.text: Obtain formal data X, structural prime identification e, covering opens V_i, and local H0 chart sections satisfying pairwise and completed-overlap restriction equations from the affine chart construction.

Apply Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing′ to glue the local sections on Y. The inverse-image opens cover O. Naturality and local matching compatibility make the global punctured section and completed section agree on each of these opens, hence globally by TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq′. Form their pair in CommRingCat.pullbackCone and transfer to matchingRing by the unique isomorphism of limiting cones; its second projection is e(h.prime).

lean.statement:
theorem exists_formalGlueingData_matching_projection
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) (t : ℕ) (f : Fin t → A)
    (hgen : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) :
    let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A
    let φ := algebraMap A C
    let g : CommRingCat.of C ⟶ Γ(E, ⊤) := (ΓSpecIso (.of C)).inv ≫ s.appTop
    letI : Module C Γ(E, ⊤) := Module.compHom _ g.hom
    ∃ (X : FormalGlueing.Data.{u, u, u} φ f) (e : X.M' ≃ₗ[C] Γ(E, ⊤))
      (k : FormalGlueing.h0 φ f X → D.matchingRing),
      ∀ h, pullback.snd
        (pullback.fst q (completionSpecMap A ∣_ U)).appTop D.toCompleted.appTop
          (k h) = e h.val.1
